chunks: 5918 - Saʿd ibn Ṭarīf narrated from Al-Aṣbagh ibn Nubātah, who said:
Amir al-Muʾminin عليه السلام said in one of his sermons:

O people, listen to my words and understand them from me, for separation is near. I am the Imam of creation, the وصي of the best of creation, the husband of the chief of the women of the community, and the father of the pure progeny and the guiding Imams. I am the brother of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, his وصي, his wali, his minister, his companion, his chosen one, his beloved, and his intimate friend. I am Amir al-Muʾminin, the leader of the radiant and marked ones, and the master of the successors. My war is the war of Allah, my peace is the peace of Allah, obedience to me is obedience to Allah, and my wilayah is the wilayah of Allah. My Shīʿah are the friends of Allah, and my supporters are the supporters of Allah. By the One who created me when I was nothing, those entrusted among the companions of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم certainly knew that the oath-breakers, the unjust, and the renegades are accursed upon the tongue of the unlettered Prophet.
And indeed, failed is he who fabricates falsehood.

key_terms.النَّاكِثِينَ وَالْقَاسِطِينَ وَالْمَارِ: the oath-breakers, the unjust, and the renegades
key_terms.النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ: the unlettered Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.الْعِتْرَةِ الطَّاهِرَةِ: the pure progeny of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.وَصِيُّ خَيْرِ الْخَلِيقَةِ: the designated successor of the best of creation

ai.seo_question: How does Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام describe his authority, wilayah, and relationship to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم in this sermon?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a sermon of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام affirming his divinely sanctioned rank, his unique relationship to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, and the theological significance of obedience and wilayah toward him. It also recalls the condemnation of the nākithīn, qāsiṭīn, and māriqīn, ending with a Qur'anic declaration against false fabrication.
